versions.changelog:
Initial release of flirt-cron (v1.0.0):

- Adds scheduled sending of romantic AI voice messages to Feishu and QQ with probability control.
- Supports custom love message library, automatic interval calculation, and custom trigger time.
- Integrates Noiz TTS for voice cloning using reference audio.
- Provides both manual and AI-guided first-time setup for user information and reference voice.
- Includes logging and troubleshooting guides for voice delivery and cloning issues.
